extensions.paletteNote: Colours are role tokens from a swappable palette. Values live only in mobile/theme/palettes/ (default calmTonalShade.js), so this file carries no colour values. Component css uses var(--role); supply those variables from the active palette to render it.

title-l.purpose: Section headers, partner and organization names.

shadows.name: footer-bar
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the app: the footer bar.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a screen, in the footer.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 56px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--onInk); font: 800 18px/24px Gabarito; letter-spacing: 0.09px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--inkPressed); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--selected); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A second action with a surface fill and an ink outline.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 56px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 800 18px/24px Gabarito; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--surfacePressed); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--selected); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above a 56 tall field; focus adds an ink border and a selected ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink); font: 700 15px/20px Figtree; } .ds-input { height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; border: 2px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 600 17px Figtree; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink3); font-weight: 500; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ink); outline: 4px solid var(--selected); }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; margin-right: 6px; border: 2px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 700 15px/20px Figtree; } .ds-chip-selected { background: var(--selected); border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-chip:active { background: var(--surfacePressed); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--selected); }

components.name: Tag
components.description: A 32 tall pill carrying a fact or a state; not a control.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); font: 700 15px/20px Figtree; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The default flat tinted container, with no border or shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border-radius: 28px; background: var(--tint); color: var(--ink); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 900 22px/28px Gabarito; } .ds-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--ink2); font: 500 15px/22px Figtree; }

components.name: List Row
components.description: A separate tinted row with a chevron; rows sit 8 apart.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 64px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--tint); color: var(--ink); font: 700 18px/24px Gabarito; } .ds-row:active { background: var(--tintPressed); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--selected); }

components.name: Disc Pair
components.description: The signature: two person discs with a solid lens holding the shift.
components.html: <svg class="ds-pair" width="190" height="120" viewBox="0 0 190 120" role="img" aria-label="Two people overlapping"><circle cx="60" cy="60" r="60" class="a"/><circle cx="130" cy="60" r="60" class="b"/><path class="l" d="M95,11.3 A60 60 0 0 0 95,108.7 A60 60 0 0 0 95,11.3 Z"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-pair .a { fill: var(--you); } .ds-pair .b { fill: var(--person1); } .ds-pair .l { fill: var(--lens1); }

narrative.overview:
The world is a community print-shop poster: flat shapes, a few inks, chunky type. A person is a flat disc in their own colour, and where two discs overlap, a third solid colour holds the shift, like two inks printed over each other. The app should feel like an invitation to do something with someone, never an admin task.

The default palette, calm tonal shade, turns that poster down without changing how it is built: an aubergine ink does the job black usually does, a heather lavender field owns one region of a screen, cards sit in a pale cool shade, and the ground stays pure white. Hierarchy comes from dramatic scale contrast, very large Gabarito heads over small, calm Figtree text. Depth comes from tonal fills and 2px borders, almost never from shadow.

Motion is deferred; static design.
keyCharacteristics: Two font families, with a wide jump between heads and body.
One colour field per screen at most, in a white ground.
Flat tinted cards and rows, large radii, pills for anything small and tappable.
A person is always a disc; a pair is two discs and a solid lens.
Every colour is a role token supplied by one palette file.

rules.name: The Colour Follows the Person Rule
rules.body: You are always `you`, on every screen. Everyone else keeps one colour, resolved through `mobile/theme/people.js`, whatever the screen or their role on it. Never tint a person with someone else's colour, and never recolour a field to match a person.

rules.name: The Solid Lens Rule
rules.body: A lens is a chosen solid token, never a blend mode or opacity. There is no three-way lens: a group of three or more is a row of ringed discs with no lens.

rules.name: The Ink Is the Black Rule
rules.body: Text is the ink family, not black or grey. On the field, text is `ink` only, never `ink2` and never white.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: A screen has one colour field at most: a hero or a status card. Quiet screens have none.

rules.name: The Skip the Middle Rule
rules.body: One large head per screen, Headline or Display S, then jump down to Title L or smaller.

rules.name: The One Fact Per Line Rule
rules.body: Metadata breaks into one fact per line. A line never ends on a separator.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The footer bar is the only shadow in the app. Cards, rows, chips and notices never cast one.

dos: Do use role tokens from `mobile/theme/colors.js` for every colour.
Do keep one primary action per screen, in the footer.
Do build lists as separate tinted rows 8 apart.
Do resolve person and lens colours through `mobile/theme/people.js`.
Do use the two-disc states for empty, ended and loading screens.
Do put shift text over a lens as real, scalable text.
donts: Don't write a colour value outside `mobile/theme/palettes/`.
Don't add a shadow other than the footer bar's.
Don't use gradients, blur, texture, or blend modes.
Don't use hairline dividers between list rows or table grids.
Don't put a tag or small label above a heading to introduce it; the heading carries itself.
Don't use serif or mono type, or a third family.
Don't use emoji, mascots or cartoon faces.
Don't add a third lens or blend three people into one overlap.
